title: get_changes_since and get_changes_since_ordered duplicate parsing/checking logic
description: contact.rs lines 276-317 and 325-359 both parse since_state, call get_state(), compare counters, and query with identical ORDER BY. Divergence risk: if the 's-N' state token format changes or the comparison logic needs fixing, it must be updated in two places. Extract a private fn parse_since_counter(since_state: &str) -> Result<(i64, String), KithError> returning (since_counter, current_state), used by both methods.
